decisions.reason: The online customer portal is still a new, uncertain option that costs little to run digitally, and it supports deeper customer collaboration, so keeping it open while its value becomes clear is worthwhile.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 is a strong early signal of value for this packaging display, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the core offer and has its own page, so keeping it costs little while its market results are still unresolved.
The small counter display fits standard display demand and uses existing capacity, making it a cheap option to hold while demand evidence accumulates.
The freestanding information display is a low-cost extension of the established portfolio with no negative signals yet, so the option stays open.
